main_text.p: ereor ne incassum laboret, atque oleum & operam perdat; primò dicit MSS. Co-P.carf. p.44. 45. lices multorum sæculorum in assignando Decreti Autore plurimùm variare, quia extat vetustissimus Codex Collectionis Dionysianæ in quo Decretum hoc Damaso Papæ tribuitur; Codex Ecclesiæ Vrgellensis,& Iurensis pervetustus ascribunt Hormisdæ;Alij Gelasium Autorem agnoscunt; mira profectò varietas, sed mirabilius Viri docti Consilium, qui in rebus nihili causæ quærit præsidium, ex infinitis ut ita dicam Gelasiani Decreti MSS. Codicibus, tres tantùm memorantur, qui in assignando Decreti Autore variant, cæteri magno consensu Gelasium Autorem agnoscunt [illegible, ~1 letter]ùm igitur tres illi codices qui variant in assignando Decreti Autore, numero sint pauciores, nec alijs antiquitate præstare dicantur, quin potior majórque debeat esse aliorum autoritas, quàm trium dubitabit nemo cui sanum erit finciput; Deinde si valet ista Viri docti ratiocinatio, quid fiet de plærísque [?]Veterum scriptorum Ecclesiasticorum libris? cùm varient sæpissimè codices in assignandis istorum librorum Autoribus; quid quæso certi remanebit? si ob quotundam Codicum varietatem, vera ac genuina scripta veris ac legitimis parenti-

page.notes: Left margin shows only fragments of the neighbouring page's edge (stray marks, "it", "js", "ed" and similar); not transcribed. The first word "ereor" is a fragment at the page edge; its first letter is cut off, so it stays a fragment. "lices" at the start of line 3 is also cut at the edge (probably "Codices"); copied as printed. The ink blot covers the first letter of "cùm" in "agnoscunt ... ùm"; marked illegible. "&ti" at the start of the line beginning "cti ratiocinatio" is partly cut off; uncertain, not marked here. The marginal note "P.carf." is in italic type.
